headline: Records housekeeping: one broken table row in the documentation is repaired
summary: Build 114 repairs one row of a table in the project records. An earlier change had cut the row short and left a stray code mark, and the reference to the post-build script is restored. Nothing about the Home Assistant product itself changed in this version.
summary_yue: 第 114 版只係修好項目紀錄入面一行表格。上一次改動令嗰行俾人截咗半截，留低一個孤零零嘅反引號，而家已經駁返好，後建置腳本嗰個參照亦都返咗。Home Assistant 產品本身喺呢版冇改動。

other.title: Repairs a table row in the records that an earlier change had cut short, restoring a file reference and its code mark. Documentation only.

no_feature_note: This version is housekeeping: a documentation fix to one table row, with nothing a person using the product would notice.
